# What would you try?

A live lesson starts with a prediction.

1. Change one thing.
2. Observe what happens.
3. Explain the difference.
slides.notes: Ask the room for a prediction before advancing. AI4 can revise this slide without editing the Kotlin talk.

slides.title: Make a slide with AI4

# Ask AI4 for a slide.

“Add a short slide about frequency after ask-a-question. Give it a prediction and a reveal.”

The source, notes and reveals stay editable.
slides.notes: Open AI4 in the presentation document. It can read files/talk.slides.json and save a single revision-checked slide. Rerun Presentation to include a newly added slide.
